clinical_changes: Source revised for plain clinical language and iCCA focality clarification; export preserves source content except hosting and evidence-access URLs.
documentation_changes: Reorganized 17 current Word documents by clinical topic, removed release-specific emphasis, retained orange high-risk headings, source links, OPEN decisions and live EndNote field structures. Public and private variants rendered and checked. No clinical threshold or matching-rule change; no native EndNote refresh is claimed.
interface_changes: Separated staged choices from confirmed findings and removed the redundant next-action selector. A compact strip opens one prior-finding editor at a time. Clinical decision numbering, conditional actions, safety findings and review statuses are retained. Roadmap topic navigation requires Open topic. Relevant numeric definitions stay visible. All seven transplant pathways and 12 roadmaps use the shared presentation.
high_risk_interface: Orange-labeled reviews at relevant standard decisions, with selection criteria, study evidence and PDF/TMC access. Standard matching rules unchanged.
contextual_routing: Answer-specific review options appear inside matching next actions after ordinary care. Clarification selectors distinguish conflated findings. Closed expansions remain explanatory; HCC-B4 remains research reference only. Earlier adverse findings carry forward and upstream edits clear dependent choices. All 46 decisions and 21 reviews checked with B/C mapping reviews and D/E clinical reviews; no selection threshold or source evidence changed.
streamlining: One current next-step result; unmatched or superseded results are reference-only. Distinct treatments keep separate conditional actions. Closed local protocols and inactive study proposals do not produce forward protocol buttons. Smaller sticky navigation and a collapsible mobile overview. Three rounds of external B/C/D/E review, with coverage limits recorded. No clinical thresholds, sources or matching rules changed.
afp_review: Separate AFP-related clinical and individual allocation review at allocation, treatment, listing and waitlist decisions. This is not enrollment in the beyond-UNOS tumor-burden pilot; standard AFP thresholds and existing study criteria are unchanged.
evidence_organization: Status, proposed position and next action precede open criteria. Searchable study summaries pair results with limitations and retain population and time-origin wording. One access record per source within each review; authority types, review coverage and approval limits are explicit. No selection criteria or matching rules changed.
criteria_display: Current threshold summaries visible; selected definitions expanded; supporting detail on demand
explanation_display: Floating info panel; phone tap/optional hold
review_scope: Analyst A implementation and regression/layout checks; external Analyst B interface and textual document review. Not clinical or institutional approval.
compact_trail_display: A short horizontal strip identifies recorded findings and the current question. Only the strip is sticky. Opening a prior finding does not change it; Apply change commits an edit and clears later dependent findings. Cancel, Escape or closing the editor discards an unapplied draft. Current threshold summaries remain visible. Roadmap chips represent navigation only, not patient findings.
single_progression_display: Choose a finding and confirm Use finding before progressing. Original definitions and conditional actions share one working area. Numbered buttons reopen earlier choices; the current marker is noninteractive. Staged changes retain Apply change and Cancel. Roadmap topic browsing is secondary to conditional next-step links. Shared/core asset version 20261026-navigation2. Preserves the concurrent clarity/evidence release af0d64a.
